verses.english: “There are these two kinds of enjoyment.
Enjoyment of things of the flesh and enjoyment of the teaching.
These are the two kinds of enjoyment.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sambhogānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammasambhogo”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of enjoyment is the enjoyment of the teaching.”
